paper.title_en: Multi-messenger detectability of continuous gravitational waves from the near future to next generation detectors
paper.abstract_en: Continuous gravitational waves have the potential to transform gravitational wave astronomy and yield fresh insights into astrophysics, nuclear and particle physics, and condensed matter physics. We evaluate their detectability by combining various theoretical and observational arguments from the literature and systematically applying those arguments to known astronomical objects and future gravitational wave detectors. We detail and update previous estimates made in support of Cosmic Explorer [M. Evans et al., arXiv:2306.13745; I. Gupta et al., Class. Quantum Grav. 41, 245001 (2024)]. It is commonly argued that the spins of accreting neutron stars are regulated by gravitational wave emission and that millisecond pulsars contain a young pulsar's magnetic field buried under accreted material. If either of these arguments holds, the first detection of continuous gravitational waves is likely with near future upgrades of current detectors, and many detections are likely with next generation detectors such as Cosmic Explorer and the Einstein Telescope. A lack of detections in the next several years would begin to raise serious doubts about current theories of millisecond pulsar formation.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文系统评估连续引力波在近期与下一代探测器中的可探测性，对毫秒脉冲星形成理论与引力波天文学交叉问题提供了可供进一步阅读的分析框架。
decision.title_zh: 从近期到下一代探测器：连续引力波的多信使可探测性
decision.abstract_zh: 连续引力波有潜力改变引力波天文学，并为天体物理学、核物理与粒子物理以及凝聚态物理带来新的洞见。我们通过结合文献中各种理论与观测论据，并将这些论据系统地应用于已知的天体对象与未来的引力波探测器，来评估它们的可探测性。我们详细阐述并更新了此前为支持 Cosmic Explorer 所做的估计 [M. Evans et al., arXiv:2306.13745; I. Gupta et al., Class. Quantum Grav. 41, 245001 (2024)]。人们通常认为，吸积中子星的自旋由引力波发射所调控，并且毫秒脉冲星在吸积物质之下埋藏着年轻脉冲星的磁场。如果这两个论据中的任何一个成立，那么连续引力波的首次探测很可能借助当前探测器的近期升级实现，而借助 Cosmic Explorer 和 Einstein Telescope 等下一代探测器则可能实现大量探测。未来几年内若缺乏探测，将开始对当前毫秒脉冲星形成理论提出严重质疑。
